bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:be4242aa-6d21-.title: Director of Culture Marketing
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:be4242aa-6d21-.description: Bumble's ability to win with the next generation of daters depends on our ability to be culturally relevant, not just participating in culture, but anticipating it, and translating those insights into meaningful business decisions. We are seeking a Director of Culture Marketing to help Bumble become one of the most culturally connected brands for Gen Z. This person will serve as our internal authority on emerging culture, trends, behaviors, creators, communities, and conversations that matter to Gen Z. They will help ensure that our brand, product, partnerships, content, and experiences feel current, relevant, and ahead of where culture is going. The role’s primary responsibility is not simply identifying trends, but transforming cultural insights into actionable strategies and marketing plans and execution that influence brand, marketing, partnerships, product innovation and audience growth. This is a highly strategic and highly influential role that will partner closely with Marketing, Product, Communications, Partnerships, Brand, and Executive Leadership to ensure Bumble remains relevant, differentiated and ahead of cultural change.
responsibilities: Be Bumble's expert on Gen Z culture—continuously identifying emerging trends, creators, brands, communities, platforms, and cultural moments that shape how young people connect, date, and socialize.
Develop and lead Bumble's cultural marketing strategy, ensuring the brand stays culturally relevant and participates authentically in the conversations that matter most to Gen Z.

Lead Bumble's celebrity, talent, influencer, and creator strategy, partnering with agencies (including UTA) to identify, negotiate, and manage talent partnerships that strengthen Bumble's cultural relevance.
Build and scale Bumble's creator ecosystem, leading our macro and micro creator strategy to drive awareness, engagement, and authentic conversation around dating on Bumble.

Partner closely with Social, Brand, PR, Creative, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Integrated Marketing teams to ensure campaigns, content, partnerships, and owned social channels consistently reflect emerging cultural trends and Gen Z behaviors.

Act as the organization's cultural advisor, regularly sharing insights, trend reports, and recommendations with leadership and helping teams identify opportunities to better connect with younger audiences.
Partner with Product to bring cultural insights into product strategy, ensuring Bumble's product experiences continue to evolve alongside changing dating behaviors and expectations.

Experience with WP Engine or comparable WordPress hosting platforms, as well as DNS, domains, SSL, CDN, and caching technologies. Experience troubleshooting website outages, server errors, SMTP and email delivery issues, and performance optimization tools such as NitroPack. Strong background in agency recruiting, specifically within life sciences recruiting. Must be a goal-oriented team player with excellent communication and presentation skills. titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:dcf54db5-3066.title: Senior Network Engineer
titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:dcf54db5-3066.description: Senior Network Engineer The Senior Network Engineer will interact directly with our high-profile, elite client base ensuring they receive our first-rate service. This position will be responsible for all network and security designs, implementations, and day-to-day support for various client network infrastructures. The Senior Network Engineer will also be an integral part in handling various networking functions including Datacenter, security and firewalling while leveraging their Cisco and Palo Alto expertise. This job is visible to all levels of Senior Management and awards the exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing, global IT services provider. The Network Engineer must display a high-level of professionalism and sound judgment at all times by promoting superior service to RFA clients. Our ideal candidate will have experience providing IT support to the financial services industry and have worked for a Managed Services Provider (MSP). RESPONSIBILITIES - Prepare complex network designs for new and existing client site establishments, site relocations, network upgrades, network expansions, and disaster recovery setups with a focus on Cisco for core network requirements - Assist in the design, build and configuration of the Global Network environments, show a strong knowledge of Datacentre technologies and be able to document these and train peers in their application - Implement and maintain logical design models (L2/L3, spanning tree, VTP, VLANs, physical cabling), remote VPN software, network control protocols (QOS, PoE, NTP, DHCP), network management protocols (CDP, FTP, TFTP, SNMP), and security protocols (SSH, HTTPS, AAA) - Provide Tier 3 support for all network and data communication issues including private and internet circuits, routing protocols, VPN connectivity, WAN optimization, hardware, and 3rd party vendor connectivity - Research networking issues and products as required and leverage critical thinking skills to evaluate all possible solutions while using appropriate judgment in applying effective resolutions - Properly address and prioritize tasks based on urgent and highly-sensitive RFA client needs and manage appropriate/realistic expectations to ensure overall client satisfaction - Responsible for configuring IPSec VPN tunnels, IP communication, and routing (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) - Leverage a strong knowledge of equipment, production processes, quality control, and other techniques for maximizing efficiency - Position is a split of BAU and Project work, time sheets are required to be completed for Client billing purposes. - Candidate will be on call for a week every staff rotation (approx. every 10 weeks) and will handle escalations from other business units. QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent level of hands-on experience. - 7-10 years of related IT experience in a Cisco environment. - Must have 5+ years of network engineering experience. - Should have CCNP or equivalent. - Has been involved in Network Design Architect work. - Advanced Routing and Switching Experience. - Must be able to travel to our Client offices and Data Centers if needed. - Palo Alto experience required, Fortigate, ASA an advantage. - Financial services industry and MSP experience is preferred. - Strong understanding of routing, WAN/LAN, and transport technologies (Ethernet, SDWAN, VPN, DMVPN, MPLS). - Excellent desktop and server troubleshooting skills. - Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Visio. - Hands-on experience with Solarwinds Orion and Kiwi, Syslog is a plus.
